exercise: Single-leg glute bridge — working leg LEFT (left foot planted)
first_frame: The attached image IS the first frame. Keep this exact person, clothing, camera angle, framing, background and lighting for the whole clip. Animate only the movement in action_timeline. Do not cut away, do not add other views or other people.

output.audio: none — completely silent, no music, no voice, no sound effects
output.loop: the pose at 0.0 s and at 8.0 s must be identical so the clip loops seamlessly

character.identity: a fit adult woman in her early 30s, athletic but not bodybuilder build, medium height, light olive skin, dark brown hair tied in a low bun, calm focused neutral expression, no tattoos, no jewelry, no visible makeup
character.wardrobe: fitted plain charcoal grey short-sleeve t-shirt; plain matte black knee-length training shorts; TEAL (#4a8894) wristband on LEFT wrist and TEAL ankle sock on LEFT foot; MUTED PURPLE (#a279a8) wristband on RIGHT wrist and PURPLE ankle sock on RIGHT foot; no shoes

environment: seamless matte charcoal studio background (#16181c), dark grey matte exercise mat on a dark floor (#24272f), nothing else in frame
lighting: soft even key light from above, subtle rim light so the limbs read clearly against the dark background, no flicker

camera.position: low, at mat level (about 40 cm high), perpendicular to the body, on the person's LEFT side
camera.framing: entire body visible with margin; head on the RIGHT of frame, feet on the LEFT of frame
camera.movement: locked-off tripod, no pan, no zoom, no shake
camera.consequence: the working LEFT leg (teal sock) is nearest the camera and fully visible

start_pose: lying on the back on the mat, arms resting flat on the mat alongside the body, palms down; LEFT knee bent with the LEFT foot (teal sock) planted flat on the mat about 30 cm from the buttocks; RIGHT leg (purple sock) held straight, lifted so the right thigh is in line with the left thigh; hips resting on the mat

action_timeline.action: drive through the LEFT heel and lift the hips until shoulders, hips and LEFT knee form one straight line; the RIGHT leg stays straight and keeps its angle relative to the thigh
hold the top position with a visible glute squeeze; hips level, no rotation
SLOWLY lower the hips back to the mat
hold the start pose, identical to 0.0 s

must: only the LEFT foot (teal sock) is on the mat; the RIGHT foot (purple sock) never touches the mat
at the top: shoulders, hips and knee in one straight line — NO arching of the lower back, ribs stay down
shoulders and head stay on the mat throughout
slow, controlled tempo with no jerks
teal stays on the LEFT side and purple on the RIGHT side for the entire clip
anatomically correct body: two arms, two legs, five fingers per hand
avoid: hips rotating or dropping to one side
